'''Sasana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] salesperson who worked for [[Kontag]]. Around [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]], she invited [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to a factory where she gave information on [[Lorian Nod]]'s whereabouts. Since Dooku expressed a wish to be allowed to visit the factories, Sasana didn't want to lose the potential order and agreed to ally the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in tracking Nod.
